name: EU Blue Card

requirements.blocker_text: Gross monthly salary of at least 1.2x Lithuania's average gross wage (approximately EUR 2,532/month, based on the 2023 average of EUR 2,110, updated quarterly) for occupations on the official high-value-added/shortage list.
Gross monthly salary of at least 1.5x Lithuania's average gross wage (approximately EUR 3,165/month) for occupations not on the shortage list.

evidence_required.document: Higher education diploma, OR 3 years' ICT-specific professional experience within the last 7 years, OR 5 years' equivalent professional experience
Formal employment contract of at least 6 months

outcome.duration_length: up to 4 years (or the contract length + 3 months if shorter), renewable

sources.title: European Commission EU Immigration Portal (Lithuania EU Blue Card page) -- salary thresholds (1.2x/1.5x average gross wage), qualification routes (degree, 3yr ICT experience, or 5yr equivalent experience), minimum 6-month contract
